promotion.reason: Observed in one brand/host transfer. Brand policy requires a second unrelated validation before promotion to a global blocking guard.

problem: Route-complete coverage and QA passed while reachable shared overlay descendants retained legacy visual and interaction systems.
abstractMechanism: A shared component rendered inside a covered route can escape coverage when the matrix treats it as incidental route content instead of enumerating its own reachable states and selectors.
appliesWhen: An apply-host target contains shared modal, overlay, drawer, viewer, sticky action, commerce, stepper, or other stateful descendant used by one or more covered routes.
evidenceRequired: shared component source and route consumers
entry path for every reachable state
selector x route x state x viewport disposition
fresh rendered evidence for every interactive state
explicit N/A evidence for unregistered or unreachable components
scriptCheck: Extend validate-host-coverage-matrix so fullHost PASS requires a declared shared-component inventory and rejects a reachable family/state absent from coverage cells.
currentRunEnforcement: Attempt28 component-state-closure is required in addition to route QA21.
promotionCondition: Promote to blocking after the same mechanism is verified on a second unrelated host or an implementation-independent inventory inspector is available.
